svg.title: Pentago: game 1, move 1
svg.desc: Game 1 of @tannergolden against GitHub, @tannergolden plays White and GitHub Black, under the Ghost Rule. Ghosts on b5 and a4. After 1. a2-ll-acw, the Arbiter's move for GitHub: a black marble on a2, then the lower left quarter turns anticlockwise. It is @tannergolden's turn as White, due by 3 Nov. The upper left quarter: a ghost on b5, a ghost on a4; the lower left quarter: Black on b1.
